# PMD runtime gotchas - the build validator does NOT catch these

Every item below was hit on a real build. The build passing tells you almost nothing about runtime; scan this list before deploying any PMD change. Grouped by layer.

**ENFORCEMENT: `scripts/pmd_preflight.py <app-root>` codifies every mechanically-detectable gotcha here (~25 checks) - run it before EVERY `wdcli app upload` (wdcli-workflow.md build loop). This list is the WHY; the linter is the enforcement. When you add a new gotcha that a source scan could catch, add its check to the linter in the same pass - "making a mistake is learning; making it twice is just being dumb."**

## Script execution & scoping

1. **A page-script function calling another page-script function returns null at runtime** (-> `JexlArithmetic.NullOperand` when used in math). INLINE all logic inside each function. A widget value-expression may call ONE script function with args; nesting is the killer. (Build only rejects functions passed as *arguments*.)
2. **Page `script`-block functions are callable ONLY from widget VALUE/rows expressions.** Calling one from an EVENT handler (`onChange` etc.) fails at runtime: "Unknown Function call: X()". Event handlers must call **script-FILE functions** (`presentation/scripts/<name>.script`, export `{ "fnName": fn }` at the bottom, include via page-level `"include": ["<name>.script"]`, call namespaced `<name>.fnName()`). Script-file functions can reference page widgets/endpoints directly. `onLoad` CAN call an included script-file function.
3. **One `let` per line.** Two declarations on one line only register the first; the second throws "Unknown Variable found" at runtime. Build passes.
4. **`null` literal breaks the build** with a useless generic "Build failed" (`setValue(null)` etc.). Clear fields with `setValue('')` - works for text AND number fields; a number set to `''` reads as empty for `required`.
5. **Reserved words:** `site` is rejected as a widget id, as a `var` name in `.script` files (hard error), AND as a member-access identifier in script files (`x.site` fails; use bracket access `x['site']`). PMD inline `<% %>` expressions tolerate `x.site`. Assume the same for `self`, `pageVariables`, `flowVariables`, `queryParams`, `endpoints`. A map KEY `'site'` (string literal) is fine.
6. `??` operator works in PMD script. Closures support `filter/map/forEach/sort/size()` and classic `for` loops. **BUT a closure cannot REASSIGN an outer variable** - `idx = idx + 1` inside a `forEach` lambda silently stays 0 forever (build passes; verified 2026-08-25 when a 348-item import all landed in batch 1 and hit the 100-item bulk cap). You cannot batch-split with a counter. Working batch recipe = **cascading forEach**: each pass splits the array into a batch (first <=100, guard with `array.size() < batchSize`) and a remainder; the remainder feeds the next forEach (verified: 348 -> 100/100/100/48, all 201s).

## Null handling (the #1 crash source)

7. **Workday Jexl throws `JexlArithmetic.NullOperand` on any `==`/`!=`/arithmetic/`'' + x` against null** - build passes, page crashes at render when a row actually has a null. Guard EVERY nullable read: test `(! empty x.flag && x.flag == true)`; exclusion `(empty x.flag || x.flag == false)`; display `(empty x.qty ? '' : ('' + x.qty))`.
8. **Records created BEFORE a BO field existed have it as null forever** (until backfilled). Adding a field => every page/report touching it needs null guards, or backfill via PUT.
9. Guard CURRENCY math with `! empty x.cost && ! empty x.cost.value` - a record can have the currency map without a value.
10. Indexing an EMPTY picker (`x.value[0]` with nothing selected) -> "Property Error found: 0". Guard with `empty` first.
11. `'' + someField` throws NullOperand when the field is null - in filters/comparisons guard first rather than coercing.

## Payloads & endpoints

12. **NEVER send JSON `null` for an optional SINGLE_INSTANCE field** - the BO API parser corrupts (subsequent keys parse as children of the null field -> S5 "unrecognized field"). OMIT the key: branch and return separate payload literals.
13. **`picker.getSelectedEntries()`, never `picker.value[0]`** - the latter returns an internal wrapper that string-concats fine but blows up Jackson in outbound payloads (InvalidDefinitionException). Coerce ids with `'' + entry.id`.
14. **Date widget values must be `.format('yyyy-MM-dd')` in outbound payloads** - raw `.value` serializes as an object and the POST/PUT fails server-side. (Date *expressions* like `date:getTodaysDate(...)` serialize fine.)
15. **BO REST `limit` max is 100** (400 S25 above that, surfacing on grids as "Property Error found: .data"). For >100 rows: paginate or use WQL.
16. **Single-instance GET exposes fields DIRECTLY, not under `.data`** - `getThing.fieldName` for `things/{id}`; `.data` is only for collection endpoints. Aliasing works: `var t = getThing; t.fieldName`.
17. **WQL instance fields are objects** (`{descriptor, id}`), not strings - store `.descriptor` into TEXT fields or you 400. SINGLE_INSTANCE fields accept `{"id": <WID>}`.
18. **BOOLEAN BO fields read back `false` when unset, NOT null** - "treat missing as true" filters fail on pre-existing rows; backfill after adding a flag and set it explicitly on every create path.
19. Endpoints referenced only inside script files compile with a "declared but never used" WARN - harmless; do NOT remove them (runtime breaks).
20. Many Workday 400s are valid JSON with an `"error"` attribute - inspect the body, don't discard it.

## Validation & required fields

21. **`required: true` on a disabled widget is NOT enforced** - submits pass with empty values. Keep required fields enabled.
22. **Conditional `required` on EDIT pages is unreliable** (expressions not re-evaluated on other fields' changes; programmatic setValue doesn't clear the error). Working pattern: `required:false` + guard the POST payload (`noItems ? 0 : (empty qty.value ? 0 : qty.value)`).
23. **`required` treats numeric `0` as "no value"** - a legitimate 0 fails the required check.
24. **Cross-field validation = the `validations` array with a `value` EXPRESSION** (evaluated at submit; TRUE = valid): `"validations": [{"value": "<% (mode=='no') || (qty>0) %>", "errorMessage": "..."}]`. This is the ONLY reliable way to block OK on a cross-field rule. Guard nulls inside the expression. The compiler WARNs this `value` expression as "unrecognized" - that warning is a KNOWN FALSE POSITIVE; the runtime honors the expression, so don't chase it. **EXCEPT ON A GRID (runtime-verified 2026-10-06, a client app builds 29daa865/168ffda3):** a `validations` entry on a `grid` widget is NEVER evaluated - a function called from it logged nothing at OK and a duplicate row saved. For a rule across grid rows use the page `onSubmit` and `setError` on a visible widget (a row's picker), which stops the outbound endpoints.
25. `checkBox` boolean reads (`.value == true`) proved unreliable as a submit gate; a `radioGroup` read via `<id>.selectedEntries[0].id` is dependable. **radioGroup shape (build-verified 2026-08-18):** populate via `instanceList` of `{id, descriptor}` entries + `selectedValues` - a `values` array of `{id, label}` FAILS to deserialize - and `<id>.getValue().get(0)` is a second verified read alongside `selectedEntries[0].id`.

## Page/flow chrome

26. **EDIT pages render OK/Cancel footer chrome by default** - and `"standardEditButtonsHidden": "<% true %>"` (a `presentation`-level property) DOES suppress it (corrects the earlier "no property suppresses it"). TRADE-OFF: once hidden, YOU own the commit - the reliable platform auto-commit is gone, so drive the write from your own `button`/`pageActionButton` `onClick`/outbound (see #28). VIEW pages have no footer but can't host input widgets. Filter bar => EDIT: accept the default OK/Cancel + gutter column, OR hide it with `standardEditButtonsHidden` and self-commit, OR move to column-header filtering on VIEW. Property confirmed against canonical DevRel samples (`createAWorkEvent/.../registerConfirmation.pmd`, `generateWQL/.../queryBuild.pmd`), 2026-08-07.
27. **Input widgets are READ-ONLY on VIEW pages** - any page with editable fields (including a filter bar) must be EDIT, wired into a flow (a no-op `outboundVariable` gives the built-in OK somewhere to land).
28. On an EDIT page the built-in OK commits reliably, so **prefer platform chrome by default** over `editButtonBar` + custom footer buttons. You CAN hide it (`standardEditButtonsHidden`, #26) - correct for a custom confirmation/micro page - but then a custom `button`/`pageActionButton` must drive the commit. Note the platform Cancel returns to the flow ORIGIN, not the previous step.
29. Naming an outbound endpoint `flowVariables` collides with the reserved flow object ("already been declared") - rename the endpoint; the write target is driven by `variableScope`/`outboundPath`, not the endpoint name.
30. `"width"` on a grid ColumnTag and `"help"` on a widget are invalid (WARN, silently ignored) - use vertical button stacking for width problems and `helpText` for help. `"selectable"` on a grid is likewise a silent no-op.
31. Horizontal sections warn unless children are containers - wrap each raw child in its own `section`.

## Files & environment

32. **PMD/JSON files must be saved WITHOUT a UTF-8 BOM** - PowerShell 5.1 `Set-Content -Encoding utf8` adds one and the build fails with "Unexpected character 0xfeff". Use `[IO.File]::WriteAllText` with `UTF8Encoding($false)` or an editor tool.
33. Extend pages are server-rendered - a failing submit is a page NAVIGATION, not a red XHR; you can't see the payload in the browser Network tab.
34. **DELETE on a BO instance referenced by another BO's SINGLE_INSTANCE returns 500** - use the soft-delete status pattern instead. From PAGE endpoints alone there is still no clean bulk/loop DELETE for a variable set of child records in one submit - design exclusion filters (e.g., skip lines whose parent is Canceled). BUT hard bulk deletes ARE deliverable via a flow: the page outbound launches a sync orchestration that first PATCHes the parent to drop the SINGLE_INSTANCE dependency, then bulk-DELETEs the children with `?bulk=true` on the collection URL (verified in a delivered production app, 2026-08-05; flow side in orchestration.md).
35. PMD scripting does NOT support higher-order functions (functions as arguments) - build error "Undefined Function".
36. Field label charset (E103): alphanumeric, space, hyphen, colon only - no `/`.
37. There is no camera widget - barcode scan = a text field + `onChange` invoke (keyboard-wedge scanners type into it).
38. **`progressIndicator` IS a native widget** (`value`, `maximumValue`, `isPercentage`, `label`) - the earlier "render a richText div with computed width" workaround is unnecessary (corrects the old "no native progress widget"). CAVEAT: its value does NOT update reactively on its own; wrap it in a `dynamicSection` and reassign `<section>.data` to force a refresh (same reactive-refresh discipline as #39). Confirmed against canonical DevRel sample `pmdWidgetDictionary/presentation/progressIndicator.pmd`, 2026-08-07.
39. Grids don't re-render reactively: recompute -> `grid.setRows(...)` and `text.setValue(...)` for metric widgets.
40. Date helper that works everywhere: `date:getTodaysDate(date:getDateTimeZone('America/New_York'))`; display timestamps via `date` widget with `datePrecision: SECOND` + explicit `dateFormat`.
41. **`attachmentList` needs an instanceList - used as a single-row grid cell it crashes the WHOLE page** (`getInstanceList() is null`), even with zero attachments. Verified attachment pattern: a `.attachment` BO uploaded via `fileUploader` + `multiPartFileLast`, then listed/downloaded via `attachmentList` bound to that BO's instance list.
42. **The `script` block is a TOP-LEVEL PMD key** (sibling to `endPoints` / `presentation`), NOT inside `presentation`. Misplacing it inside `presentation` fails compile with a confusing "Undefined Function" on the page-script functions - check the key's nesting before debugging the function bodies.
43. **An endpoint with literal `"exclude": true` is PARKED - it never fires**, and a failing outbound response is not guaranteed to surface usefully. When modifying a downloaded app, check `exclude` before assuming an endpoint runs (delivered apps keep alternate/retired endpoints in source this way). Make failure behavior explicit: `failOnStatusCodes: [{"code": 400}, ...]` declares which statuses abort the submit, and `responseErrorDetail.errorSummary` (expression with implicit `error`/`errors` variables) shapes the message the user sees. Verified in a delivered production app, 2026-08-05.
44. **An apostrophe/contraction inside a single-quoted JEXL string literal closes the string early** (`<% 'the task's panel' %>`) -> build error "PMD Scripting syntax error ... Parsing Error". Plain JSON strings (`helpText`, `_comment`) are unaffected. Rephrase to avoid apostrophes in JEXL literals, or build the string differently. Verified in a delivered build session, 2026-08-05.
45. **An UNSET boolean on POST or full-replace PUT stores `false` - and if that boolean is a soft-delete/visibility gate, records SILENTLY VANISH.** A full-replace PUT rebuilt in `onSend` without the field (e.g. an edit page that omits `active`) flips it to `false` on every save, and the record disappears from every `active`-filtered list - no error anywhere. Set the gate explicitly on create (`active: true`) and carry it on every PUT (`'active': (empty a.active ? true : a.active)`); when ADDING such a field, grep every POST/PUT body in the app first (model.md checklist item 3). Verified the hard way, 2026-08-05.
46. **Summing a DECIMAL field with `+` string-concatenates** - BO REST serializes DECIMAL fields as JSON STRINGS (INTEGER fields arrive as real numbers - model.md). A dashboard total built in a loop with `+` over `estHours` yields `"1.53.25.0"`-style garbage, silently. Coerce each term numerically with **`(x - 0)`** (JEXL numeric coercion via subtraction - verified working, 2026-08-05) before adding. Same asymmetry breaks `numberAtJsonPath*` in orchestrations reading the BO - see orchestration.md.
47. **On an EDIT page, grid cells with `cellTemplate: {type:"text"}` become EDITABLE inputs** - users can type into your report grid. Bites exactly when a list/dashboard page turns EDIT to host a filter bar (the #27 chain). FIX + standing rule: use **`{type:"readOnlyText"}` for ALL grid cellTemplates** - display-only on EDIT pages, renders identically on VIEW, and valid inside cellTemplates (not just standalone). Verified at scale: ~91 cells swapped app-wide, build clean, filters (onChange->setRows) unaffected. Default to readOnlyText even on VIEW pages - any list page can later gain a filter bar. Verified in a delivered build session, 2026-08-06. Linter #47 grades by the page's `pageType` (2026-10-10): WARN on an EDIT page or one that declares no pageType; on a declared VIEW page, one INFO line per grid instead - the cells are static there, so it is the house rule, not a runtime defect.

48. **A deferred endpoint's `wqlQuery.parameters` bound to `queryParams` returns EMPTY from the same page - bind to a live WIDGET read instead.** Refined understanding (runtime-verified 2026-08-20): declared `parameters` expressions DO evaluate at `.invoke()` time and CAN read page widgets - the trap is the SOURCE. `queryParams` only exist after a page round trip, so a same-page cascade bound as `{p: "<% queryParams.id %>"}` executes `WHERE x = ''` - zero rows, no error, looks like a data problem. Fix: bind the declared parameter to the live widget (`"fy": "<% empty picker.getSelectedEntries() ? '' : ('' + picker.getSelectedEntries()[0].id) %>"`) and call `.invoke()` with no args. Both binding forms + the warning: efficiency.md "Endpoint passes the parameter". (queryParams binding stays correct for detail pages reached by NAVIGATION.)

49. **`endpoint.invoke({args: {...}})` does NOT override a declared `wqlQuery.parameters` binding** - when an endpoint already has a declared `wqlQuery.parameters` block, the declaration wins at every invocation; the `args` hash passed to `.invoke()` has no effect on it. If you need a fully dynamic parameter at invoke time, leave `wqlQuery.parameters` out of the endpoint definition entirely and supply the value only through invoke. Sibling trap to #48 - both come from the same deferred-binding mechanics. (Verified in a delivered build session, 2026-08-20.)

50. **`multiline: true` on a `text` widget is invalid** - the build WARNs and silently ignores it; the field renders single-line at runtime. Use the `textArea` widget type instead (native, sample-confirmed in pmd.md). Also: **`headerSize` on a `title` widget is rejected by the compiler** - pmd.md's cheat-sheet note that `title` accepts `headerSize: "VPS_DEFAULT"` is wrong; omit the property. (Both verified in a delivered build session, 2026-08-18.)

51. **Hub sub-page id ENDING in lowercase `home` (`"home"`, `"shippinghome"`, ...) collides with the app's built-in home hub** - Workday's hub router pattern-matches the id, routes the page at `/w/hub/<pageid>` (a hub-LANDING route), and wraps it in the Home shell (cityscape banner, "Good Morning" greeting, global search bar) regardless of your hub layout. SYMPTOM: exactly ONE page shows a big top banner the others don't; DIAGNOSE by checking the browser URL for `/w/hub/` (the page source is byte-identical to clean pages - the id is the only difference). FIX: rename to a distinct camelCase id (`shippinghome` -> `shippingPlanner`) and update the `.pmd` id + filename, the AMD task id/routingPattern/page.id, every nav `taskId`, and any pod/card `taskId` pointing to it (capital-case ids like a `shippingHome` POD are fine). (Verified in a delivered build session, 2026-08-14.)

52. **Script-side `.invoke()` POSTs in `onSubmit` are TRANSACTIONAL - rolled back when the EDIT page closes.** Each POST returns 201, then the created instances vanish (reopen the page, REST GET finds 0). `setError()` in onSubmit also forces rollback - but even a clean submit did not persist. The durable page-write paths are the FRAMEWORK-managed ones: grid `outboundFields` and `onSend` outbound endpoints (see pmd.md outbound section). Do not build imports on script-side invoke writes. (Verified in a delivered build session, 2026-08-25.) OPEN companion (suspected, same family): an outbound POST on a MID-FLOW EDIT step with an editable field may not persist under either `onSend` or `values`, while identical patterns work from `startsFlow` steps or read-only steps - if a mid-flow write won't stick, move the POST to the startsFlow step or a read-only confirm step and retest.

53. **`.keySet()` does not exist in page expressions** - runtime "Internal Server Error: Unknown Function call: .keySet()" and the page will not open; the build does not catch it. To debug an unknown response shape: skip map introspection entirely - probe with direct property access + null-safe fallbacks (`resp.data ?: []`) and print sizes/first elements into a `pageVariables` debug string rendered in a `richText`. (Verified in a delivered build session, 2026-08-25.)

54. **A page deferred endpoint POSTing to `/orchestrations/<flowName>` returns 404** even when the flow exists and the URL is right - deferred invoke is NOT a page->flow bridge; the only proven bridge is the outbound `POST <FlowName>/launch` on the `workday-orchestration` provider (pmd.md). Also: that provider's base URL has NO trailing slash - an endpoint URL without a leading `/` concatenates into garbage (`orchestrationsbulkPublish...`). (Verified negative result, 2026-08-25.)
55. **`pageActionButton` onClick does NOT fire on standalone EDIT pages accessed via AMD routes** - the button renders and is clickable but the onClick script silently does nothing (no pageVariable changes, no invokes). Tested with hardcoded strings, `date:now()`, and deferred endpoint invokes - all silent. The widget catalog lists it as working (`buttons.pmd`, `queryBuild.pmd`) but those are in-flow sample pages. For standalone pages (direct AMD route, no flowDefinition), use regular `button` navigation to a separate VIEW page instead. (Verified negative result across 4 consecutive deploys, 2026-08-26.)
56. **A VIEW page with a deferred POST endpoint errors on load ("POST inbound endpoint couldn't be loaded") unless navigated to via `commandHttpMethod: "POST"` on the source button.** The error message gives the fix: set `"commandHttpMethod": "POST"` on the `button` widget that navigates to the target page. This tells the platform to load the page via POST, enabling the POST endpoint. The resulting pattern - VIEW page + deferred POST endpoint + `commandHttpMethod` button - is the PROVEN mechanism for bulk BO creation from a page: VIEW pages have no edit transaction, so deferred `.invoke()` POSTs in onLoad persist (unlike EDIT pages which roll back per #52). (Verified working pattern, 2026-08-26.) **Counter-observation, 2026-10-10 (one data point, a different entry route):** a VIEW page opened as a Workday **Custom Task tab** on a delivered object (Job Requisition > Details tab, task route `/HomeView/{customTaskObjectId}`, a plain GET) loaded normally while declaring one never-called deferred POST endpoint (`BoPatchItem/launch`, `authType: sso`). No load error, no console error from the page. So the load failure seen 2026-08-26 is not universal: it may depend on the entry route (in-app button vs Custom Task tab) or on the endpoint never being invoked. Before relying on either behaviour, probe the exact entry route with one never-called endpoint and open it once (cheap, reversible).
57. **Standalone outbound endpoints (no grid row binding) NEVER fire on pages with `standardEditButtonsHidden: true`** - the outbound needs a submit trigger (OK button), and `standardEditButtonsHidden` removes it. The `pageActionButton` onClick does NOT trigger outbound endpoints either. Outbound endpoints may fire with a visible OK button (not yet verified), but the VIEW page + deferred invoke pattern (#56) bypasses this entirely. (Verified negative result, 2026-08-25/26.)

58. **An `instanceList` (picker) with `onSearch` still fails the build unless it ALSO carries one of `instanceList` / `values` / `instanceListLoopTag`.** The `onSearch` handler alone is not enough. Seed an empty `"values": "<% [] %>"` to satisfy the compiler; the search populates it at runtime. (Verified in a delivered build session, 2026-08-26.)

59. **`endpoint.invoke(bodyObject)` SILENTLY DROPS the POST body** - passing the payload as an ARGUMENT to `.invoke()` runs the call with no error (looks like success) but sends NO body, so 0 instances persist. The body must come from the endpoint's own `values` + `outboundPath`, NOT an invoke argument: define `"values": [{"outboundPath": "data", "value": "<% pageVariables.payload %>"}]` on the deferred POST endpoint, set `pageVariables.payload` FIRST, then call `.invoke()` with NO arguments. This is the payload mechanism behind the VIEW-page bulk-create pattern (#56). DANGEROUS silent-success failure - suspect it whenever a POST "succeeds" (200/201) but nothing is written. (Verified in a delivered build session, 2026-08-26.)

60. **EDIT-grid `outboundFields` POST can SILENTLY FAIL to create BO instances** - user adds rows, clicks Save, the flow returns 200 but 0 instances are created, no error surfaced. Seen on a simple BO (no custom BP) in a delivered app, 2026-08-26; ROOT CAUSE UNKNOWN (possibly auth, or a framework limit for simple BOs). (!) reconcile: this coexists with the 2026-08-25 note that grid `outboundFields` IS the framework page-side BO-create path (pmd.md) - it worked for some BOs and silently failed for another in the SAME app, so do NOT treat `outboundFields` as guaranteed for a new simple-BO create. Reliable fallback = the VIEW page + deferred POST (`values`+`outboundPath`, #56/#59) pattern. Isolate the cause before relying on outboundFields for BO creation.

60a. **Widget method calls (`x.setValues(...)`, `x.setValue(...)`) inside `onLoad` crash the page at runtime** - "Internal Server Error ... Unknown Variable found: <widgetId>" (build passes). `onLoad` runs BEFORE widgets are instantiated, so widget ids are unknown variables there. Correct split: `onLoad` computes into `pageVariables` only (endpoint `.invoke()` + data shaping are fine); widgets BIND to them via their `values` expression (`"values": "<% pageVariables.usageTypes ?? [] %>"`) which evaluates at render, after onLoad. Widget method calls belong ONLY in event handlers (`onChange`, `onSearch`, `onClick`), which run with widgets live. (Verified Role Pairing addMappedReport, 2026-08-31.)

61. **A `.card` footer link does NOT carry `commandHttpMethod`** - a card footer navigating to a page that has POST deferred endpoints makes the target page error (the POST endpoint can't load; same class as #56). Card footers cannot set `commandHttpMethod: "POST"`. Use a regular `button` widget with `"commandHttpMethod": "POST"` + `taskReference` to reach a POST-endpoint page. (Verified in a delivered build session, 2026-08-26.)

62. **Deferred endpoint `.invoke()` ONLY supports GET and POST HTTP methods** - DELETE and PUT both fail at runtime with "UnsupportedOperationException: Http method DELETE/PUT from inbound endpoint <name> is not supported." This is a PLATFORM limitation on deferred endpoints invoked from page scripts, not a per-page or per-navigation-method restriction. Workaround for BO "delete" operations: use an **append-only parity pattern** - POST a new record with a `removed: true` flag instead of deleting, then load cart/list by counting adds vs removes per item (adds > removes = active). For true DELETE/PUT, use EDIT-page grid outbound endpoints (submit triggers CRUD) or orchestrations. (Verified negative result for both DELETE and PUT in the same session, 2026-08-28.)

63. **Duplicate endpoint names across a page's `endPoints` array and an included pod cause a runtime error** - "Failed to process pod. The endPoint name(s): '<names>' exist on both the pod: '<podId>' and pmd: '<pageId>'." The build does NOT catch this. When a pod provides an endpoint (e.g. `getCurrentUser`), do NOT redeclare it in the page's own `endPoints` - the pod version is available to the page directly. Scan for collisions whenever adding a pod include to an existing page. (Verified in a delivered build session, 2026-08-28.)

64. **Loop `as` variables are NOT accessible inside event handlers (onChange, onClick) of child widgets** - the `as` variable (e.g. `roleItem` in `"as": "roleItem"`) works in static property expressions like `label`, `value`, `render`, but referencing it in an `onChange` handler throws "Unknown Variable found: roleItem.<field>". WORKAROUND: use `self.label` (or another `self` property you set from the loop variable in a static expression) as an indirect key. Example: set `"label": "<% roleItem.displayName %>"` on the widget, then in onChange use `pageVariables.selections[self.label] = self.value`. Match by displayName (not ID) in the submit handler. If display names aren't unique, use a grid (which exposes rowVariableName in cellTemplates AND onSend) instead of a loop. (Verified in UAP v2 checkoutWizard - instanceList inside loop, onChange referencing loop var crashed, self.label fix deployed 2026-08-28.)

65. **A `type: "hidden"` cellTemplate in a LIST grid does NOT expose its `.value` to outbound endpoint `exclude` conditions** - `empty zoneConfigId.value` always evaluates as empty/true even when the hidden field is populated with a valid WID from the API response. This causes CREATE endpoints to fire for ALL rows (including existing ones that should be excluded), duplicating every record on save. FIX: use **`type: "text"` with `enabled: false` and `visible: false`** on the column instead of `type: "hidden"`. **CORRECTED 2026-10-21 (see #88): NOT `render: false`.** An unrendered widget is never built, so its value reads empty at OK on stored rows. STANDING RULE: never use `type: "hidden"`, and never `render: false`, for any field whose value an outbound endpoint reads - use disabled-text with `visible: false`. (Verified in a delivered a cross-dock app-style app, 2026-08-28: switching from hidden to disabled-text on the ID column immediately fixed the duplicate-on-save behavior.)

66. **A "read existing items then deduplicate" import check that uses the default `?limit=100` silently truncates.** Items 101+ look "new" on every run -- a Setup Wizard or import flow with this pattern re-creates the full set as duplicates on each execution. The bug manifests as the collection growing by the full catalog size on every test run (e.g. 348 -> 602 -> 856...) with nothing visibly wrong per-write. Fix: paginate the existence check (use a WQL COUNT or the pagination node to read ALL existing items), or use a true unique-key upsert (`updateIfExists=true` on bulk POST where available). (Build+deploy verified, UAP v2 Setup Wizard, 2026-08-31.)

67. **`radioGroup` onChange does NOT drive dependent UI on server-rendered EDIT pages** - the click commits the selection to the widget model, but `setVisible`/`setValues`/`setValue` calls inside the radio's `onChange` never produce a re-render (the dependent widgets stay in their initial state). Hit TWICE in one session (Role Pairing PoC, 2026-09-01): a live-mode acknowledgment checkbox that never appeared, and a method-dependent reference picker that never populated. Contrast: `instanceList` onChange + `setValue` works fine (verified same session - a rule picker filling a derived-text field). FIX PATTERN: never hang required UI off a radio's onChange - make dependent widgets ALWAYS visible with when-it-applies labels, enforce with submit `validations`, and derive radio-dependent values in `onSend` instead of via a picker (e.g. mapping reference derived from method).

68. **`richText` strips styled `<div>` HTML** - inline-styled flex/card markup renders as one concatenated plain-text run (sanitizer keeps only basic tags like `<b>`/`<br>`). For KPI strips/dashboard cards use NATIVE widgets: horizontal section of nested sections, each a disabled `text` widget (label above, computed value below). (Verified live, Grant Ledger dashboard, 2026-09-01.)

69. **Chart 2.0 build-required attributes beyond the obvious:** `donutChart2` REQUIRES `sliceColorDataSet` (build error "missing the required attribute sliceColorDataSet"), and every `categoryDataSet` REQUIRES a `name` (build error "CategoryDataSet is missing the required attribute name"). Both errors surface only at upload. (2026-09-01.)

70. **Grid `columns` entries need `"type": "column"` AND `columnId`** - a column written as bare `{label, cellTemplate}` fails the build with the unhelpful "Specify the type attribute, which is missing or invalid for pmd: <page>". (2026-09-01.)

71. **A grid on an EDIT page renders Add Row / Remove Row controls unless the grid carries `"enabled": false`** (re-confirmation of the kitting note - the ledger grid shipped editable until the flag was added; the empty gutter column still remains, that's inherent to EDIT). Also: direct-URL deep links to `micro` EDIT page routes redirect to home - micro pages are reachable only via buttons/flows. (2026-09-01.)

72. **Hub page-type rules bite at build AND runtime** - an EDIT page in a hub's `navigationTasks` is a hard BUILD error; a `taskReference` to an EDIT page opens a MODAL (nav preserved) while a `taskReference` to a VIEW page BREAKS OUT of the hub frame (left nav lost); a hub nav group caps at 5 items. Plan every hub page's `pageType` around these before building - full rules and the canonical VIEW-landing-plus-EDIT-modal shape in pmd.md ("Hub navigation behavioral rules"). (Build+runtime verified.)

73. **`instanceList` type-ahead V2 quirks (beyond the onSearch build rule #58):** (a) the FIRST search often renders a **blank-but-SELECTABLE result row** (latency under proxy) - the record is correct, clicking the blank row selects it and the chip shows the right name; a second search in the same modal renders labeled rows, so do NOT diagnose "no results" from the first blank render. (b) **`values`-based pre-populate does NOT render stored SINGLE_INSTANCE references** in an EDIT-modal instanceList (`values: "<% pageVariables.ownerValues %>"` with `[{id, descriptor}]` stays empty even when the data is stored and correct) - save paths stay safe if `onSend` only writes the field when `getSelectedEntries()` is non-empty (a PATCH that omits the field preserves it), but admins see an empty picker on reopen. (Verified in a delivered build session.)

74. **Widget-id ambiguity from pods - two silent classes (build-verified 2026-08-20):** (a) a GRID whose `id` matches its pod's `podId` makes `setRows`/`getSelectedRows` references ambiguous - they do not reliably resolve to the intended widget, and nothing fails at build time; give every grid an id distinct from its pod's podId. (b) ONE POD INSTANTIATED TWICE on a page produces DUPLICATE widget ids - any handler addressing a pod-internal widget by id is ambiguous across the two live instances. Fix: one pod per tab/instance rather than reusing a parameterized template twice - which also retires the `@@status@@`-style conditional render expressions that accumulate inside a shared template (a maintainability trap of its own as instances grow). Endpoint-name collisions between pod and page are the sibling trap (#63).

75. **`onSearch` fires on TYPING, not on OPENING the picker** - a cascade wired to the child picker's `onSearch` shows an EMPTY list to any user who clicks the dropdown without typing (the normal interaction for a short list), while the handler tests as demonstrably correct when you type. Build the cascade on the PARENT's `onChange` so the child's `values` are already populated before it is opened (pmd.md "Cascading picker"). (Runtime-verified 2026-08-20.)

76. **`selectedValues` alone renders BLANK - a picker restore needs a `values` list containing the selected entry.** A cascading picker that must survive a page reload / validation round trip therefore needs TWO endpoints over the same query: the deferred one for live interaction (parameter bound to the parent widget - #48), plus a NON-deferred twin - `exclude`-gated when its parameter is absent - that refills `values` server-side on load. Without it the page looks correct on first use and silently loses the selection on any round trip. (Runtime-verified 2026-08-20.)

77. **Pod `parameters` accept only a SIMPLE binding** - a complex expression (JSONPath filter, JEXL closure filter) fails with "PMD Scripting syntax error in PodTag:parameters". Pass the raw endpoint reference and filter INSIDE the pod template, where full expressions work. Related: a plain `button` must carry `taskReference`/`workdayTaskReference` - a button with only `label` + `action` fails validation, and the error reports the PAGE id as the Button ID, which hides the actual widget; for an in-page action that does not navigate, use `pageActionButton` + `onClick` (but see #55 for its standalone-page limitation). (Build-verified 2026-08-18.)

## WQL correctness & ship-readiness (MDR Program review, 2026-09-04)

78. **WQL belongs in an externalized `.wqlquery` COMPONENT, never inline in an endpoint url - and NEVER on a non-WQL endpoint type.** Two grades: (a) a `SELECT` string-built into the `url` of a WQL endpoint (`baseUrlType` `workday-wql` or `wql`) is legal but violates the house rule - one query, one home (`presentation/wqlQueries/<id>.wqlquery` referenced by `wqlQuery:{queryId}`), so maintenance happens in ONE place and there is no `\"`-escaping (WARN). (b) the same `SELECT` on a REST/app endpoint (any other `baseUrlType`) is the wrong endpoint TYPE entirely (FAIL). The MDR review hit both - `getProgram`/`getProgramBySearch` carried the full query inline. Sibling inbound endpoints (`functionGETSearch`) already used the component correctly, so the fix is to make every WQL query match the convention. *Linter #78 catches this (grep-equivalent: a `SELECT ... FROM` inside an endpoint `url`).* **Call these out to the user and get confirmation before mass-correcting an app you were handed.**

79. **NEVER guess WQL field names - they fail at RUNTIME (400 Internal Server Error), not at build.** A wrong SELECT/WHERE field passes the build and the page compiles, then dies at render: `RestRequestException: Inbound endpoint request failed (400): .../wql/v1/data`. The MDR review: `SELECT programObject ... referenceIDValue` when the source's REAL fields are `program` and `referenceID1` (and the row map then read `x.programObject` instead of `x.program`). This is the SELECT-field companion to wql.md's "descriptor is not the alias" (that one is the FROM source). **Verify EVERY field against `dataSources/{id}/fields` or by running the query live (WQL REST + wdcli token) before ship** - and never copy a field list across objects (a Program is not a Cost Center; the fields differ). Not statically lintable without the schema - it is a hard process rule; the cheap guard is a live smoke-run of each touched `.wqlquery`.

80. **No `Lorem Ipsum` / placeholder values in a shippable page.** A hardcoded `instanceList` `[{id:'loremipsum', descriptor:'Lorem Ipsum'}]` with no `searchEndPoint`, or leftover "Lorem Ipsum" copy, means a stub was scaffolded and never wired to its real inbound endpoint - it cannot resolve real values at runtime. Either wire the endpoint or, if the page is a deliberate not-yet-built stub, prefix its id `DNU`. Also (MDR #4): comment out or KT-comment any Session-Variable/`onLoad` script left inert - do not ship uncommented dead onLoad logic (the review found `console.info(query)` debug lines left in inline queries). *Linter #80 flags Lorem-Ipsum in any non-DNU page.*

## Reuse discipline - you OWN every line you copy

81. **Scaffolding a new page/flow/script from a sibling vertical or a template is fine - copying it VERBATIM is the #1 defect.** The MDR Program pages were built by copying Cost Center pages, which carried over the wrong endpoint type, another object's field names, and placeholder values into the new object. When you reuse: know exactly what each copied block does, then ADAPT it to the new object - field names (verify against the source, #79), endpoint TYPE and externalization (#78), script variable names, widget bindings, labels, and placeholders. A build pass proves none of this; the page 400s or shows the wrong data at runtime. This is the build-side twin of the design rule "read the full design, don't infer a vertical from its sibling." State what you changed and why when you hand the work back.


## Build-verified additions (2026-09-04, corporate-card build)

- **[BV] JEXL textual OPERATOR keywords are illegal variable names in scripts:** `eq, ne, lt, gt, le, ge, and, or, not` - `for (var ge = 0; ...)` fails the build with a bare 'PMD Scripting syntax error' on that line. Watch for them as short loop-index names.
- **[BV] `attrstore` is a RESERVED keyword inside `.script` FILES** (same class as `site`): referencing it at all fails the build ('contains reserved keyword(s): attrstore'). It works fine in PMD inline expressions - read the attribute in the page (e.g. onLoad) and pass it into the script-file function as a parameter.
- **[BV] An `instanceList` REQUIRES exactly one of `instanceList` / `values` / `instanceListLoopTag`** even when it is an onSearch-only type-ahead - give it `"values": "<% [] %>"`.
- **[BV] `values` (and similar list props) reject a LITERAL JSON array** - 'Cannot deserialize DynamicBinding<List> from Array value'. Wrap static option lists in an expression: `"values": "<% [ {'id':'x','descriptor':'X'} ] %>"`.
- **[BV] `taskReference.parameterBindings` is a MAP, not an array:** `"parameterBindings": { "ruleId": "<% row.id %>" }`. The array-of-{name,value} form fails deserialization (LinkedHashMap<String,Binding> from Array).
- **[BV] S101/S102 build validation forbids a security domain name that matches a BO name or a REST collection name.** Source code predating this rule (e.g., ported from an older org) fails a fresh build unchanged with a cryptic validation error. Fix: rename the offending `domains` entries in the `.businessobject` file (e.g., if your BO is `CreditCardApplication` and a domain was also named `CreditCardApplication`, rename the domain to something distinct like `ManageCreditCardApplications`). [Corporate Card Requests build, a dev tenant, 2026-09-04]

## Pod / script gotchas on custdev-era platform (2026-09-04, corporate-card runtime bring-up)

- **`@@paramName@@` POD-PARAMETER substitution is BROKEN on the current platform** (a custdev-era tenant). A pod
  seed `template` referencing `<% @@historyRows@@ %>` with the host page passing `parameters: {historyRows:
  'endpoint.data'}` DOES NOT textually substitute - the grid receives the literal STRING and you get
  `class java.lang.String cannot be cast to class java.util.List` at runtime (build passes; the ported
  hackathon app used this pattern). FIX: drop the `@@` parameter; bind the pod widget to a `pageVariable` the
  host page sets in onLoad (`"rows": "<% pageVariables.historyRowsData ?: [] %>"`, host onLoad sets
  `pageVariables.historyRowsData = endpoint.data`). Pods share host page scope, so pageVariables read cleanly.
- **Script-FILE namespaces (`myScript.fn()`) do NOT resolve on a pod-based / basicFormLayout page** even when
  the include + export shape exactly matches a working plain-section page. Symptom: `Unknown Function call:
  .fn(...)` (namespace resolves null). Reporting-style plain-section pages work; pod pages do not. FIX: inline
  the logic into onLoad / the onSend expression directly (no script file). Verified across single- and
  multi-include, include-position-top, and comment-stripped variants - none fixed it; only inlining did.
- **DEFERRED endpoints are invisible to onLoad** - `deferredEndpoint.invoke()` from onLoad throws `Unknown
  Function call: .invoke()`. Only NON-deferred endpoints expose `.data` to onLoad. For load-time reads, make
  the endpoint non-deferred and read `.data`; a dependent endpoint's URL can parse another endpoint's `.data`
  to build its query (data-dependency ordering), and use `exclude` to skip it when the input is empty.
- **`selectionEnabled` wants the STRING `"true"`, and `maxRowSelection` a NUMBER** - a boolean
  `selectionEnabled: true` or string `maxRowSelection: "1"` are both ClassCast risks; match the working
  exampleapp grid (`"selectionEnabled": "true"`, `"maxRowSelection": 1`).

**Counter-evidence from a later tenant (wcpdev, a client app, runtime-verified 2026-10-03/04).**
Two notes above did not hold there, so treat them as tenant- or era-specific, not universal:
- **Deferred `.invoke()` from onLoad works** there: the page's onLoad calls several deferred
  orchestration endpoints in sequence and reads their results.
- **Script-file namespaces resolve on pod pages** there, and a pod's `onChange` can call a function
  defined in the host page's own script (side effects only). The W5 failure that looked like this
  ("Unknown Variable found: <script>") was entry #83 - PMD markers in a comment - not the pod.
  Check for #83 before concluding a namespace cannot resolve.

## Grid rendering gotchas (UAP v2 build, 2026-09-10)

82. **Single-column grid `columnId` collision renders ALL cells blank (build+runtime-verified 2026-09-10):** When a grid has exactly one column and its `columnId` matches a key name in the row data map, the Extend platform silently overrides the `cellTemplate` expression and every cell renders blank - even though row count is correct. Multi-column grids with the same pattern work fine. **Fix:** use a `columnId` that does NOT match any row data key (e.g. `"secGroupCol"` not `"groupName"`, `"orgCol"` not `"org"`, `"detailCol"` not `"detail"`). Audit every single-column grid in the app when this symptom appears; 3 grids were affected in UAP v2 and none failed the build. Related: entry #70 (columns need `"type": "column"` + `columnId`).

83. **PMD expression markers inside a `.script` file - even in a comment - stop the script loading at runtime (build+runtime-verified 2026-10-03, a client app).** A doc comment that quoted a usage example with its opening and closing expression markers (`<%` ... `%>`) built clean, but every page that included the script failed at load: "Internal Server Error ... Unknown Variable found: <scriptName>". The file's whole module simply did not exist at runtime, so the error names the SCRIPT, not the line. Removing the markers from the comment - and nothing else - fixed it on the next deploy. **Rule:** never write `<%` or `%>` in a `.script` file; describe the calling expression in words. **Diagnosing the symptom:** "Unknown Variable found: <scriptName>" on a page that lists the script in `include` means the file failed to load, not that the include is wrong - look for constructs no other working script in the app uses, starting with these markers. *Linter #83 FAILs on any `<%`/`%>` in a .script file.* (A first fix attempt that rewrote three other unproven constructs - an arrow function inside a template placeholder, a method call on an array literal, a local function call inside a placeholder - did NOT clear it; those constructs remain unproven rather than disproven.)

84. **Runtime facts proven by the a client app per-location fetch (build 67b910db, wcpdev, 2026-10-04).** Each was unproven in that app before W7 and is now observed live:
    - **A deferred `.invoke()` inside a `forEach` lambda in a script file works** - one orchestration call per list item, results collected by mutating outer lists (`rows.addAll(...)`, `outcomes.add(...)`). Reassigning an outer variable inside the lambda still does nothing (#6).
    - **`let` inside an `if` block, and inside a lambda block, works.** Block-level `const` was avoided (no precedent); prefer `let` there.
    - **`{:}` is the empty-map literal** in page script and script files alike (`{}` would be a set).
    - **Case-insensitive equality** with the proven pair `a.length() == b.length() && a.containsIgnoreCase(b)`; `toLowerCase` / `equalsIgnoreCase` / `trim` remain unproven in PMD.
    - **A richText's `.value` set from a script-file function renders `<b>` and `<br>`** - good for a multi-line status banner on an EDIT page (render it on a page-load fact, give it a first text in onLoad, rewrite `.value` after each action).
    - **A grid column's `render` is decided once, at page render.** A column keyed on the row data (`!empty rows.find(r => r.location)`) stays hidden for rows assigned later with `grid.rows = ...`, and there is no way to show a column from script. Key it on a page-load fact (`pageVariables.hasJobReq`) and let the cell show a placeholder when a row lacks the value.
    - **Define functions before the line that calls them** inside a script file. Forward references were never observed to fail, but closures may capture variables at creation; the app's guard enforces define-before-use.

85. **A deferred `.invoke()` shows the platform page error when the flow COMPLETES with a non-JSON answer, and returns an EMPTY answer when the flow FAILS - the script cannot branch on either (runtime-verified 2026-10-05, corrected 2026-10-07 from the developer-site log, a client app).** The two cases are the opposite of what you would guess. (1) **Vendor answers 403 with an HTML body:** `SendHttpRequest` on a default retry config does not fail on a 4xx, and `data.<Send>.response.asJSON()` does NOT check the body (log: "JsonType runtime instance created for data with content type application/octet-stream"), so the flow completes. The page then fails to read the answer and shows "Page Error: Internal Server Error [id] ... ObjectMapperException ... JsonParseException", aborting the click handler at the invoke - no later line runs. (2) **Vendor unreachable (unresolvable host):** the send step fails ("Unable to resolve IP address from URL", retries exhausted), the flow fails, and the deferred `.invoke()` comes back EMPTY with no page error - a picker fed by it is silently empty. Proven three times: the flow failed every time (a `math.div(1, 0)` value step raised "/ by zero"; a false ContinueOnConditions assertion raised its own message) and the page showed nothing. Consequences: (a) "loud failure" tests must break the vendor AFTER the page is open (flows read App Attributes at run time; a break before open fails at the app's own auth step instead); (b) **`bestEffort: "true"` does NOT help** on a deferred endpoint (runtime-verified 2026-10-05, build ddeb3103) - the 403 case is not a failed launch at all; (c) **read the developer-site log before diagnosing** - the screen cannot tell a failed flow from an empty result (three deploys were spent on this before the log settled it). Preflight WARN #85 flags bestEffort on a deferred endpoint. **Proven fix for a caller that must see every failure (runtime-verified 2026-10-05 to 2026-10-07, builds c2384e82 to e3e5a6e7):** the new caller sends a header (`X-Fail-Soft: true`) and every existing caller sends `false`, so the old path is untouched. In the flow: (i) guard the parse step - `if (data.<Send>.responseStatusCode.is2xxStatusCode() || <header is true>.not()) data.<Send>.response.asJSON() else s"${"{\"state\": -1, \"messages\": [\"...HTTP "}${data.<Send>.responseStatusCode}${"...\"]}"}".asJSON()` - this turns a 4xx into a structured error answer; (ii) put a ConditionalOutputs ErrorHandler on the send step AND the parse step, each logging `data.<Node>.processingError.message()` and letting the flow carry on - this catches no-connection and timeouts (when the send fails, `responseStatusCode` does not exist, so the parse guard fails too: "Referenced output responseStatusCode ... does not exist in data context"); (iii) a last ContinueOnConditions step asserting `(data("<Send>","isSuccess") == true && data("<Parse>","isSuccess") == true) || <header is true>` re-fails the flow for the old caller, as before; (iv) EndSync returns the shaped `{state: -1}` answer when a step failed and the header is true, else the parse result. A flow-level GlobalErrorHandler CANNOT do this: it cannot read `data.start` (build error "There is no upstream component with id start"). Result live: the fail-soft caller got the message on 403 and on no-connection, per location, and the click carried on; the old caller still got the platform error on 403 and an empty picker on no-connection, exactly as the original flow does. **Correction 2026-10-08:** the status check in that pattern must not read every non-2xx as a failure. the vendor sends its "no data" answer (state 2) with HTTP 404, and the first form of the check reported it as "The call failed (HTTP 404)". Pass any reply carrying the vendor's own answer shape through, whatever its status (`response.toString().contains("\"state\"")`, placed after the caller test), and probe the vendor's no-data replies before writing the guard - error-handling.md, "A vendor's non-2xx can be a valid ANSWER".


86. **A bare `return;` inside a PMD page `script` is a build-time Parsing Error (build-verified 2026-10-06, a client app build 0e851a3c).** The build reports "PMD Scripting syntax error in Pmd:script: Parsing Error" on the surrounding block, then "calls an undefined function" for EVERY function in that script (onLoad `main`, onSubmit handler), because the whole script fails to parse. Use if/else to skip the rest of a handler. Preflight FAIL #86. Related trap from the same session: a quoted ternary inside a template interpolation (`{{x == 'a' ? 'b' : 'c'}}`) was the first suspect; compute such values into a variable before the template.

87. **Completing an Extend BP action step: `POST eventSteps/{id}/submit` takes one optional `comment` and NEVER `stepAction` (runtime-verified 2026-10-06, a client app: both stepAction refusals AND the comment-only success - HTTP 201, step Submitted, event Successfully Completed, build `d82eedc9`).** Workday's Submit Event Steps REST API (Extend API gateway only) documents the request body as `{ "comment": "..." }` or `{}`. `stepAction` ("Submitted") appears only in the reply. Sent in a request it builds clean and is refused live: the step's task WID gives "Invalid id for field" (field=stepAction); the delivered Submit step-action WID gives A169 "This step isn't valid for submission". Two neighbours from the same defect: `/approve` on an action step gives A190 "This event step type cannot be approved", and a refused call returns an error object rather than throwing, so check `res.error` before reporting success anywhere. *Preflight FAIL #87.* Full pattern and prerequisites: model-bp.md "Completing an action step from a page".

88. **CAUSE FOUND AND FIXED 2026-10-21: the culprit was `render: false`. Use `visible: false` (runtime-verified, build f5138b25).** `render: false` means the widget is never built, so its value cannot be read at OK (diagnosis from the engagement's senior Extend developer). With `text` + `enabled:false` + `visible:false` on the record-id carrier, an edit of a stored row PUT in place (twice, no duplicate), a standalone form widget updated a stored row (twice), and a new row still POSTed - all proven by WQL read-back. **DELETE PROVEN 2026-10-22:** with the same carrier, a removed stored row was deleted on OK (the delete-confirm on Yes), and the kept row was not rewritten (same id, same timestamp, by WQL read-back). Add, edit and remove are all proven. Linter #88 FAILs a `render: false` widget whose value an outbound endpoint reads. Original 18 Oct finding follows. The `text` + `enabled:false` + `render:false` carrier cell is NOT reliable for an outbound `exclude` once the grid has changed. A removed row fires NO outbound endpoint at all.** Seen live on 2026-10-18, on an EDIT-page grid of stored BO rows with three outbound endpoints keyed on a hidden record-id cell: POST excluded when the id is set, PUT and DELETE excluded when it is empty. The administrator removed one stored row and pressed OK. The developer-site log shows exactly ONE BO call: a POST (201) for the KEPT row, so its id cell read empty and a duplicate was created. No PUT. No DELETE for the removed row, so it was never deleted. This contradicts the pmd.md / #65 advice that this carrier shape gates `exclude` correctly. Treat it as safe only for rows the user ADDS (see pmd.md caveat (a): pre-populated rows only fire when edited). Do not design update or delete of stored rows around per-row outbound excludes. Send the whole row set to an orchestration that decides POST/PUT/DELETE server-side, or use a VIEW page plus deferred calls for creates and an orchestration for PUT/DELETE (#62). Always read the save back by WQL after the first live save. Source: one engagement's v2 app, defect B45; log query `wd_page_id:"<page>" and wd_http_method:(POST or PUT or DELETE)`.

89. **A `{{...}}` slot in a template string only sees the enclosing function's own names (runtime-verified 2026-10-22, build 9cfd417d).** Parameters and the function's own `const`/`let` resolve. A script's own top-level `const` does NOT: the build passes, and the page fails at runtime with "WelException: JEXL error ... '<name>' exception error : failed to evaluate '<the template>'" on the widget that called it. Seen when a card's help line used a file-level task-name constant. Fix: copy the value into a local `const` first, then use the local in the slot. Page endpoints (`{{getRtiReqsById...}}`), the platform's `site` and namespace calls like `{{date:now()}}` do resolve. *Preflight FAIL #89.* The same scan found two latent cases in one app's admin screen (a cap message that would have failed the page only when the cap was exceeded), so run it on every app, not just the page that broke.

90. **A grid cell widget's `label` is drawn inside the cell when the cell's fieldSet holds more than one widget (runtime-verified 2026-10-22).** With one widget in the cell, the label does not show, but the platform uses it in the required-field message ("The field Projects is required and must have a value." instead of "The field  is required..."). So label every required cell widget that is alone in its cell. Leave a widget unlabelled when it shares its cell, for example with a hidden record-id carrier (#88); its required message then names no field. Pin the choice with a static guard.
